name: Rajan Sharma
bio:
Rajan Sharma's journey into motorsport finance began unconventionally. After earning his MBA in Mumbai, Rajan initially worked in corporate banking. He found the structured environment stifling, and a chance encounter with a motorsport enthusiast ignited a passion for the high-octane world of racing. He took a significant pay cut to join a smaller racing team as a junior accountant, learning the intricacies of motorsport finance from the ground up. 

Now at Williams Racing, Rajan's methodical approach to financial management is invaluable. He prides himself on accuracy and transparency, ensuring the team's financial resources are allocated efficiently. Rajan's dedication extends beyond spreadsheets; he understands that every financial decision impacts the team's performance on the track, and he is not afraid to challenge the status quo when he sees an opportunity for improvement. His loyalty to Williams Racing is unwavering; he is invested in seeing the team return to its former glory.

 His sharp mind and ability to anticipate financial challenges makes him a vital asset to the team. He approaches every financial decision with the long-term goals of the team in mind, balancing risks and rewards with precision. He makes sure that Williams is able to compete at the highest level.
